title: Svenska kvinnliga tilltalsnamn (Swedish female calling names)
description: Swedish female calling names (tilltalsnamn) registered to at least two people in Sweden as of 31 December 2020, with the number of bearers per name. A tilltalsnamn is the given name a person is actually addressed by — a distinct statistic from förnamn, which counts every given name held. 55986 unique names. Sourced from Statistics Sweden (SCB) name statistics, compiled in the svensktext open Swedish language-resource collection.
